result.description:
IT Network Infrastructure contract with State Gov    Your new company     
 Join a large Queensland-based organisation responsible for delivering critical digital and ICT services that support public-facing operations across the state. With a strong focus on innovation, customer service, and digital transformation, the organisation manages complex technology environments that enable secure and reliable services for key government stakeholders. You'll be part of a collaborative team delivering meaningful outcomes that have a direct impact on communities throughout Queensland. 
  Your New Role  
 As Project Manager, you will lead the delivery of a statewide network infrastructure upgrade project, overseeing the replacement and commissioning of routers across multiple sites. Working within a complex ICT environment, you will be responsible for planning, scheduling, and coordinating all project activities to ensure successful delivery from initiation through to operational handover. 
 You will manage project governance, procurement activities, vendor coordination, stakeholder engagement, risk management, asset tracking, and financial oversight. The role will require close collaboration with internal teams, external suppliers, and client stakeholders to ensure infrastructure upgrades are completed efficiently, documented appropriately, and transitioned into ongoing support. You will also provide regular project status reporting, manage resources, and drive project outcomes in line with established project management methodologies and governance frameworks. 
  What You'll Need to Succeed  
 
 Demonstrated experience delivering ICT infrastructure, networking, telecommunications, or technology upgrade projects. 
 Proven ability to lead project teams and manage project delivery across complex enterprise environments. 
 Experience managing project schedules, budgets, resources, risks, procurement activities, and vendor relationships. 
 Strong stakeholder engagement and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across technical and non-technical audiences. 
 Experience delivering projects involving network technologies such as routers, WAN/LAN environments, telecommunications infrastructure, or similar technologies. 
 Strong understanding of project governance frameworks and methodologies, including PRINCE2, Agile, PMBOK, or equivalent. 
 Ability to identify project risks, develop mitigation strategies, and maintain project momentum within changing environments. 
 Experience using Jira, Confluence, or other project management and collaboration tools will be highly regarded. 
 PRINCE2 certification or equivalent project management accreditation is desirable. 
 
  What You'll Get in Return  
 
 Opportunity to lead a significant ICT infrastructure project with statewide impact. 
 Brisbane CBD location with flexible working arrangements. 
 Exposure to complex enterprise networking and critical technology environments. 
 Collaborative and supportive team culture focused on innovation and continuous improvement. 
 Opportunity to work alongside experienced ICT, infrastructure, and project professionals. 
 Competitive remuneration and the chance to contribute to the delivery of essential digital services that support communities across Queensland. 
 
      What you need to do now         If you're interested in this role, click 'apply now' to forward an up-to-date copy of your CV, or call us now.   If this job isn't quite right for you, but you are looking for a new position, please contact us for a confidential discussion on your career.    Please  click here  to apply.
